name: Profile Systems & Software SA
summary: Profile Systems & Software SA develops software solutions for the banking and investment management industry in Europe, the Middle East, Asia, Africa, and the United States. The company provides AI.Adaptive that transform data for financial institutions; Finuevo Suite, a smart banking platform for all banking functions of conventional banks, digital banks, EMIs, and MFIs; Finuevo Digital, a digital banking software solutions; and Finuevo Core, a software solution for global financial institutions and fintech start-ups.
